acceptanceCriteria: receipt compact --help states the elided-receipt restore cost for complete audit walks and names the fast route that avoids it
The owning spec section carries the same statement, and a help golden test covers it
body: GitHub #1063 ask 4, not covered by V1-1626 (COMPLETED via #1089). A 2 s sample showed snapshot ReceiptRestorer.Next at about 20% of complete-walk samples after receipt compact elided 8,882 receipts. Expected: corvint-tasks receipt compact help (and its spec section) says complete audit walks restore elided receipts and cost more, and when the writer-checkpoint fast route avoids that. Actual: help is silent.
title: receipt compact help: state that complete audit walks over elided receipts cost more (#1063 ask 4)
